strategy: BR blight attrition — undercosted counter-laden fat
identity: BR attrition, built on a pricing error the cube makes on purpose: it sells large creatures cheaply by making them ENTER with -1/-1 counters. Moonshadow is a 7/7 menace for a single black mana that arrives carrying six counters — so it is a 1/1 on turn one. Creakwood Safewright is a 5/5 for two that arrives as a 2/2. Heirloom Auntie is a 4/4 for three that arrives as a 2/2. The deck's whole job is to settle that debt, and it does so three ways: it removes counters outright (Perfect Intimidation removes ALL counters from a target creature — the only cross-body remover in the colours), it lets bodies repair themselves (Heirloom Auntie on every creature death, Moonshadow on every permanent card reaching the graveyard, Creakwood Safewright each end step while an Elf card is in the yard), and where a counter cannot be removed it is SPENT — Gnarlbark Elm turns two into -2/-2, Brambleback Brute turns one into an unblockable attacker, and Retched Wretch turns one into a free return from the graveyard. Gristle Glutton and Gutsplitter Gang manufacture the counters those spenders run on, for free, every turn.

restrictions.build_constraint: at most 5 rare+mythic cards total across mainboard and sideboard

mainboard.name: Moonshadow
mainboard.oracle_text:
Menace
This creature enters with six -1/-1 counters on it.
Whenever one or more permanent cards are put into your graveyard from anywhere while this creature has a -1/-1 counter on it, remove a -1/-1 counter from this creature.
mainboard.role: Apex threat: 7/7 menace for {B}, six counters to shed

mainboard.name: Dawnhand Dissident
mainboard.oracle_text:
{T}, Blight 1: Surveil 1.
{T}, Blight 2: Exile target card from a graveyard.
During your turn, you may cast creature spells from among cards you own exiled with this creature by removing three counters from among creatures you control in addition to paying their other costs.
mainboard.role: The pool's only repeatable CROSS-BODY counter remover; also graveyard exile and an Elf card

mainboard.name: Creakwood Safewright
mainboard.oracle_text:
This creature enters with three -1/-1 counters on it.
At the beginning of your end step, if there is an Elf card in your graveyard and this creature has a -1/-1 counter on it, remove a -1/-1 counter from this creature.
mainboard.role: Threat: 5/5 for two that repairs itself while an Elf card is in the yard; it is itself an Elf card

mainboard.name: Gristle Glutton
mainboard.oracle_text: {T}, Blight 1: Discard a card. If you do, draw a card. (To blight 1, put a -1/-1 counter on a creature you control.)
mainboard.role: Free every-turn blight source + loot; recharges the counter-spenders and draws

mainboard.name: Nameless Inversion
mainboard.oracle_text:
Changeling (This card is every creature type.)
Target creature gets +3/-3 and loses all creature types until end of turn.
mainboard.role: Interaction + a changeling Elf card for Creakwood Safewright

mainboard.name: Bogslither's Embrace
mainboard.oracle_text:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, blight 1 or pay {3}. (To blight 1, put a -1/-1 counter on a creature you control.)
Exile target creature.
mainboard.role: Interaction: unconditional exile; its blight loads a spender

mainboard.name: Sear
mainboard.oracle_text: Sear deals 4 damage to target creature or planeswalker.

mainboard.name: Heirloom Auntie
mainboard.oracle_text:
This creature enters with two -1/-1 counters on it.
Whenever another creature you control dies, surveil 1, then remove a -1/-1 counter from this creature. (To surveil 1, look at the top card of your library. You may put it into your graveyard.)
mainboard.role: Threat: 4/4 that repairs itself on every creature death and surveils

mainboard.name: Gnarlbark Elm
mainboard.oracle_text:
This creature enters with two -1/-1 counters on it.
{2}{B}, Remove two counters from this creature: Target creature gets -2/-2 until end of turn. Activate only as a sorcery.

mainboard.name: Brambleback Brute
mainboard.oracle_text:
This creature enters with two -1/-1 counters on it.
{1}{R}, Remove a counter from this creature: Target creature can't block this turn. Activate only as a sorcery.
mainboard.role: Threat + counter-spender: one counter makes an attacker unblockable

mainboard.name: Retched Wretch
mainboard.oracle_text: When this creature dies, if it had a -1/-1 counter on it, return it to the battlefield under its owner's control and it loses all abilities.
mainboard.role: Threat that returns when it dies carrying a counter

mainboard.name: Graveshifter
mainboard.oracle_text:
Changeling (This card is every creature type.)
When this creature enters, you may return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.

mainboard.name: Gutsplitter Gang
mainboard.oracle_text: At the beginning of your first main phase, you may blight 2. If you don't, you lose 3 life. (To blight 2, put two -1/-1 counters on a creature you control.)
mainboard.role: 6/6 that enters with NO counters and manufactures 2 every turn for the spenders (held to 1 copy: at 2 the blight glut kills the deck's own 2-toughness bodies)

mainboard.name: Perfect Intimidation
mainboard.oracle_text:
Choose one or both —
• Target opponent exiles two cards from their hand.
• Remove all counters from target creature.
mainboard.role: Payoff: removes ALL counters from target creature, or strips two cards, or both

mainboard.name: Blood Crypt
mainboard.oracle_text:
({T}: Add {B} or {R}.)
As this land enters, you may pay 2 life. If you don't, it enters tapped.

mainboard.name: Geothermal Bog
mainboard.oracle_text:
({T}: Add {B} or {R}.)
This land enters tapped.

mainboard.name: Evolving Wilds
mainboard.oracle_text: {T}, Sacrifice this land: Search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
mainboard.role: Land; sacrificing it puts a land card in the yard, a live Moonshadow trigger

sideboard.name: Feed the Flames
sideboard.oracle_text: Feed the Flames deals 5 damage to target creature. If that creature would die this turn, exile it instead.
sideboard.when_to_board: vs decks whose threats come back - the exile clause is the only permanent answer in these colours

sideboard.name: Rooftop Percher
sideboard.oracle_text:
Changeling (This card is every creature type.)
Flying
When this creature enters, exile up to two target cards from graveyards. You gain 3 life.
sideboard.when_to_board: vs recursion decks (39 graveyard-interaction cards, 15.0% of the cube); its changeling also makes it an Elf CREATURE card in your own yard

sideboard.name: Blight Rot
sideboard.oracle_text: Put four -1/-1 counters on target creature.
sideboard.when_to_board: vs decks whose best creature has 4 or less toughness; four counters at instant speed

sideboard.name: Giantfall
sideboard.oracle_text:
Choose one —
• Target creature you control deals damage equal to its power to target creature an opponent controls.
• Destroy target artifact.
sideboard.when_to_board: vs Equipment or mana-rock decks (11 artifacts, 4.2% density). Board mode one only alongside a full-size body - most of this deck's creatures arrive shrunken, so 'damage equal to its power' is small on arrival

sideboard.name: Nightmare Sower
sideboard.oracle_text:
Flying, lifelink
Whenever you cast a spell during an opponent's turn, put a -1/-1 counter on up to one target creature.
sideboard.when_to_board: vs fast aggro - it is the evasive blocker AND the lifegain the raced mode concedes the maindeck lacks, and its trigger fires off the deck's 5 instants

strategy_es: desgaste de blight BR — gordos infracosteados cargados de contadores
identity_es: Desgaste BR, construido sobre un error de precio que el cubo comete a propósito: vende criaturas grandes baratas haciendo que ENTREN con contadores -1/-1. Moonshadow es un 7/7 con amenaza por un solo maná negro que llega cargando seis contadores, así que es un 1/1 en el turno uno. Creakwood Safewright es un 5/5 por dos que llega como 2/2. Heirloom Auntie es un 4/4 por tres que llega como 2/2. Todo el trabajo del mazo es saldar esa deuda, y lo hace de tres formas: retira contadores directamente (Perfect Intimidation retira TODOS los contadores de una criatura objetivo, el único removedor entre cuerpos de estos colores), deja que los cuerpos se reparen solos (Heirloom Auntie con cada muerte de criatura, Moonshadow con cada carta de permanente que llega al cementerio, Creakwood Safewright en cada paso final mientras haya una carta de Elfo en el cementerio), y donde un contador no puede retirarse se GASTA: Gnarlbark Elm convierte dos en -2/-2, Brambleback Brute convierte uno en un atacante imbloqueable, y Retched Wretch convierte uno en un retorno gratuito desde el cementerio. Gristle Glutton y Gutsplitter Gang fabrican gratis, cada turno, los contadores con los que funcionan esos gastadores.
